name: Echo Bleed
lore: Hears fragments of memories from the implant's previous carriers.
upside: Scouting: reveals one extra node on expedition maps; occasional insight into enemies.
downside: Silence and isolation raise stress; she misremembers events as hers.

breakdown.name: Overwritten
breakdown.text: Acts as a previous carrier for the rest of the expedition (random skill use, may call the commander by another name).

social: Scenes where she shares a memory that is not hers; can learn facts about the setting the player should not know.

arc.embrace: She starts choosing echoes to wear.

name: Loyalty Imprint Fracture
lore: Factory loyalty to the corporation is broken.
upside: Trust gains +50%; immune to enemy-corporate morale effects.
downside: Leash Compel costs double Trust with her and has a chance to fail.

breakdown.name: Unbound
breakdown.text: Ignores all orders, fights her own way.

social: Tests the commander constantly; despises corporate talk; values honesty over authority.

arc.embrace: She becomes a free agent who stays by choice, or does not.

name: Threat Saturation
lore: Threat-detection firmware never turns off. Paranoid.
upside: Never ambushed; reaction shots on enemy entry.
downside: Cannot benefit from Rest nodes; stress rises in "safe" places and crowded scenes.

breakdown.name: Hostile Read
breakdown.text: Attacks the nearest target, ally included, once.

social: Suspects squadmates and the commander; trust is slow but very sticky once earned.

arc.embrace: Her threat map is shared with the squad.

name: Compulsive Protocol
lore: Rigid routine loops from training firmware.
upside: +15% damage and CRIT when she keeps the same row and skill rotation.
downside: Plan changes (row swaps, Fall Back, changed loadouts) give stress and -SPD.

breakdown.name: Loop Lock
breakdown.text: Repeats her last action regardless of target validity.

social: Needs schedules; reacts badly to the commander being late or breaking routine; values kept promises highly.

arc.embrace: Perfect drill: the squad syncs to her rhythm.

name: Affect Dampener Fault
downside: Affinity and Attraction gains halved; struggles to read others.
social: Flat affect; rare, intense breakthroughs when something finally reaches her are relationship milestones.

arc.manage: Learns with the commander to name emotions.

name: Rage Governor Failure
upside: +ATK scaling with stress (+1% per stress point above 30).
downside: Insults, refusals and being ordered back raise stress sharply; chance to ignore Hold the Line.

breakdown.name: Red Out
breakdown.text: Attacks the strongest visible target, ignores CP orders.

social: Fights with squadmates and the commander; apologizes badly; values directness.

arc.manage: A sparring outlet in the Training Yard.

name: Latent Strain
lore: A suppressed Bloom strain lives in her.
downside: Each breakdown risks mutation progress (a hidden clock); supplies-hungry suppressant upkeep.

breakdown.name: Bloom Surge
breakdown.text: Massive damage to everyone in her row, allies included; mutation clock +1.

social: Fear of turning; disgust or pity from squadmates; strongly tied to the strain_trade and experimentation crimes.

arc.embrace: She learns to steer the strain.

name: Hunger Loop
upside: Heals 5% max HP per turn in combat.
downside: Consumes double supplies; supply shortage hits her stress hardest.

breakdown.name: Feeding Frenzy
breakdown.text: Attacks enemies regardless of orders, heals per hit.

social: Food is a love language; cooking and meal activities give her extra Affinity.

arc.embrace: She feeds on what she kills (unsettling).

name: Pain Inversion
upside: +damage while wounded; ignores stun from damage.
downside: Hides injuries: injuries she gets last longer and can worsen silently.

breakdown.name: Reckless Advance
breakdown.text: Moves to front row and refuses retreat.

social: Worries others; scenes about care and checking on her.

arc.manage: The commander checks on her after each expedition.
arc.embrace: A wall that will not fall.

name: Graft Rejection
upside: After medbay maintenance: +20% all stats for 3 days.
downside: Without maintenance, loses max HP over time.

breakdown.name: Collapse
breakdown.text: Falls to 1 HP, out of action for 2 turns.

social: Dependence on the commander's access to the medbay; pride vs need.

name: Overclock Bias
downside: After combat, overheat reduces stats on the next expedition unless she rests a slot.

breakdown.name: Thermal Runaway
breakdown.text: Acts twice, then shuts down for the rest of combat.

social: Restless, never sits still; rest activities with someone raise Affinity more.

name: Sensor Ghosting
downside: 10% chance per attack to target a ghost (miss).

breakdown.name: Phantom Fire
breakdown.text: Shoots at nothing for the rest of the round, stress to allies nearby.

social: Unsure what is real; asks the commander to confirm things; truth matters to her.

name: Firmware Rollback
lore: Occasionally reverts to an old firmware with an old personality and old orders.
upside: Unlocks 1 extra skill from her "old profile".
downside: Random rollback events: she treats the commander as a stranger for a day.

breakdown.name: Old Orders
breakdown.text: Follows her previous commander's directives (which may be hostile).

social: Haunted by who she was; possible link to the commander's crime (liquidation).

name: Target Lock Persistence
downside: Cannot switch target until it dies or 3 turns pass.

breakdown.name: Friendly Lock
breakdown.text: Locks onto an ally for one attack.

social: Fixates on goals and people; stubborn.

arc.embrace: The lock persists across expeditions (nemesis enemies).

name: Imprint Hunger
lore: Bonding firmware needs regular contact with an imprinted person.
upside: +stats when the imprinted person is in the same expedition or scene.

breakdown.name: Withdrawal
breakdown.text: Ignores orders until she reaches the imprinted person.

social: The imprint target can be the commander or a squadmate; drives night visits.

nightEvents.framing: {name} comes to you shaking; the withdrawal has started and you are the only thing that helps.

name: Possessive Protocol
lore: Treats one chosen person as an "assigned asset".
downside: Jealousy events; Trust/Affinity penalties when the commander favors others.

breakdown.name: Claim
breakdown.text: Attacks whoever is near the chosen person.

social: Feeds the obsessed state; conflicts with a second romance.

name: Reward Loop Damage
upside: Stress relief from pleasurable activities is doubled.
downside: Risk-seeking: chooses risky options in events, harder to keep disciplined.

breakdown.name: Binge
breakdown.text: Abandons the objective for the nearest reward (loot node, etc.).

social: Flirtatious and impulsive; boundaries are a recurring theme in scenes.

name: Compliance Craving
lore: Performs best under strict command; autonomy causes distress.
downside: Stress when left without orders or given free choice; Leash usage is less damaging to her Trust, which tempts the commander to abuse it.

breakdown.name: Lost
breakdown.text: Passes her turns until given an order.

social: The moral trap is explicit: easy to exploit, harder to help her want things for herself.
